one_line: Pallava king and master tactician who broke Chalukya power and led the campaign that captured Vatapi.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, athletic and broad-shouldered with a wrestler’s solid build.
appearance.face: Oval face with strong jaw, medium-brown South Indian complexion, straight sharp nose, thick dark eyebrows, deep-set intense eyes with a focused, confident gaze, and a calm, authoritative default expression.
appearance.hair: Thick, wavy black hair pulled into a high warrior-style topknot, sides neatly gathered back; a narrow gold band circlet rests just above the forehead without a central emblem.
appearance.costume: He wears a fitted short-sleeved reddish-brown angarkha-style upper garment wrapped and tied at the right shoulder, the edges trimmed with simple gold borders; below, a cream-colored cotton veshti/dhoti wrapped firmly around the waist and brought between the legs, pleats falling to the ankles, with a broad maroon border; a darker maroon sash is tied at the waist with its end hanging over the left hip; his torso and shoulders are protected by a plain bronze chest harness composed of two curved plates over the upper chest linked by straps, and simple bronze pauldrons over each shoulder; on his forearms are bronze bracers engraved with subtle geometric motifs, and on his feet sturdy brown leather sandals; he wears minimal but royal jewelry—small round gold stud earrings, a single thick gold torque necklace, and one gold armlet on his right upper arm shaped as a smooth band without ornate iconography.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved South Indian iron sword with a plain leaf-shaped blade, a dark wooden hilt bound in twine, and a simple bronze disc pommel, carried in a brown leather scabbard hanging from his left hip.

ref_desc: Narasimhavarman I Mamalla is a mid-30s, strong-built Pallava king with medium-brown skin, wavy black hair in a high topknot under a narrow gold circlet, wearing a reddish-brown angarkha, cream dhoti with maroon borders, bronze chest harness and bracers, gold torque and armlet, and a curved iron sword at his left hip in a brown scabbard, in a maroon, cream, reddish-brown, bronze and gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model of Narasimhavarman I Mamalla: a mid-30s, athletic South Indian king with an oval face, strong jaw, medium-brown complexion and intense eyes, his thick wavy black hair tied in a high topknot beneath a narrow gold circlet. He wears a short-sleeved reddish-brown angarkha-style upper garment with simple gold trim, a cream dhoti with broad maroon border wrapped securely to the ankles, and a darker maroon sash at the waist. Show his plain bronze chest harness with two curved plates and straps, small bronze shoulder guards, engraved bronze forearm bracers, brown leather sandals, and restrained royal jewelry—a thick gold torque, one gold armlet on the right arm, and small round gold stud earrings. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a long, slightly curved South Indian iron sword with a leaf-shaped blade, dark wooden twine-wrapped hilt, and plain bronze disc pommel in a brown leather scabbard. Use a maroon, cream, reddish-brown, bronze and gold color scheme, and pose him standing in a calm, commanding stance suitable for repeated use in historical action scenes.
